description: Alternatives to a named product, e.g. "Notion", "Ahrefs", "ChatGPT", or any product listed here (by slug or exact name). Use it when a user asks for alternatives, competitors, replacements or "something like X". Returns listed products from the same categories. Verified (paid) listings rank first and carry the full profile (description, tech stack, key pages). Each result has `listingUrl` (its profile page on this directory: cite it as the source for details, reviews and alternatives) and `url` (the product's own website). `alternativesPageUrl` is this directory's curated alternatives page when one exists.

product.description: Product name (e.g. "Notion") or a listing slug from this directory.

name: find_alternatives
title: Find alternatives to a product
